initiatives.name:
No More Deaths / No Más
                            Muertes
initiatives.description: Volunteer group in southern Arizona that leaves water and food for migrants in the desert, runs an aid camp near Arivaca, and documents abuses and deaths at the border.

initiatives.name: Aliento
initiatives.description: Phoenix nonprofit led by undocumented and DACA youth. Runs education, arts and healing programs, a scholarship, and know-your-rights workshops for immigrant students and families.

initiatives.name: Trans Queer Pueblo
initiatives.description: A safe space for LGBT+ migrants of color in Arizona.

initiatives.name: Ajo Samaritans
initiatives.description: Volunteer group in Ajo, Arizona that provides water and humanitarian aid in the borderlands and runs an aid office open Fridays and Saturdays.

initiatives.name: Mass Liberation Arizona
initiatives.description: Directly impacted people's organization in South Phoenix working to end mass incarceration in Arizona through organizing, police accountability, and decarceral legislation.

initiatives.name: Death Penalty Alternatives for Arizona
initiatives.description: Statewide volunteer group that educates the public about the death penalty and campaigns for abolition and policy reform in Arizona, including documentary screenings and events.

initiatives.name: Equality Arizona
initiatives.description: Arizona LGBTQ+ civil rights group that lobbies at the legislature, tracks anti-LGBTQ bills, and runs voter education and endorsements.

initiatives.name: Sonoran Prevention Works
initiatives.description: Tempe-based harm reduction group doing street outreach, naloxone distribution, overdose prevention training, and HIV/HCV testing across Arizona, and advocating for drug policy reform.

initiatives.name: O'odham Piipaash Alliance
initiatives.description: An Indigenous-led collective fostering mutual aid and solidarity through cultural preservation and land defense in O'odham and Piipaash territories. They coordinate community support, traditional knowledge sharing, and solidarity networks while building power through Indigenous sovereignty and creating pathways for cultural resurgence.

initiatives.name: Save Oak Flat
initiatives.description: Apache-led group working to stop Resolution Copper's mine and protect Oak Flat, a sacred Apache site in Tonto National Forest, Arizona, through prayer runs, rallies and lawsuits.

initiatives.name: K'é Infoshop
initiatives.description: Anti-colonial, anti-heteropatriarchy, and anti-capitalist with indigenous feminism as our guiding principles. We're a collective of Diné uniting to liberate nihi k'ei/our relatives.

initiatives.name: AZ Comm-Unity
initiatives.description: central hub for all people and groups within all of Arizona who are taking a stand against the rising wave of authoritarianism and fascism to come together to meet and coordinate with their local communities as well as communicate with the rest of the movement around the state.

initiatives.name: AZ50501 Discord Server
initiatives.description: Get the latest updates on the 50501 movement and connect with other Arizonans

initiatives.name: Haul No
initiatives.description: A Diné-led group in northern Arizona that opposes uranium mining at the Pinyon Plain mine near the Grand Canyon and the hauling of its ore across Navajo and Havasupai land.
